title: Document
description: Top-level UDM document. The shape of `content` is determined by `mode`.

udm_version.description: SemVer of the UDM spec this document conforms to.

extensions.description: Adapter-specific opaque data preserved verbatim through round-trip. Keys must be namespaced as `<adapter>.<key>` (UDM_SPEC.md §3).

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the source bytes.

FontResource.description:
A font face usable by text content. The `source` field tells the editor whether glyph fallback may be needed: - `Embedded` → may be a subset; check `has_glyph` before insertion - `System`   → assumed full font, but availability not guaranteed at render time - `Google`   → fetch from Google Fonts CDN - `Substituted` → original font wasn't available; `substituted_for` names the original

(See `project_alldocs_pdf_adapter.md` lesson #1.)

_meta.description: Adapter-specific opaque metadata (e.g. PDF subset prefix). Reserved per spec §13.

StyleProperties.description: Reusable style block referenced from content via `style_id`.

Length.description: A length value with an explicit unit. Importers should preserve the unit from the source format when possible; the editor and exporters convert as needed.

ColorRef.description: Color reference: either a literal value or a pointer to a named ColorResource. Exactly one of `ref` / `literal` should be present; we don't enforce that at the type level (it's a spec validation concern, see UDM_SPEC.md §12).

ColorValue.description: Concrete color value in one of several color spaces.

LineHeight.description: Line height: either a unitless multiplier (e.g. 1.5) or an explicit length.

Edges_for_Length.description: Edge values keyed by side (top/right/bottom/left). All sides optional; missing sides mean "no override".

EmbeddedObject.description: Opaque container for embedded OLE objects, charts, and other format-specific payloads we don't yet model structurally. v0.2 will define typed variants.

Content.description: Discriminated union of content trees. Disambiguated by which top-level field is present (each content type has unique fields: `blocks`, `pages`, `sheets`, `slides`, `primary`).

oneOf.description: Generic embed for math, charts, OLE, iframes etc. Payload shape depends on `kind`.

Mark.description: Inline-level formatting overrides that sit on top of a TextRun's `style_id`. Tagged enum: serialized as `{ "type": "bold" }`, `{ "type": "color", "color": ... }`, etc.

flow_projection.description: Optional reflow-friendly projection of this page's content. Importers that can produce one (e.g. when a PDF has a tagged structure tree) store it here so the editor can offer a "edit text" UX without losing the underlying fixed layout.

Layer.description: Layer in a Page. Tagged by `type`; rendered back-to-front in array order.

oneOf.description: Annotation kinds: highlight, comment, stamp, ink, link, redaction. kind-specific payloads are stubbed for v0.1; v0.2 will define typed variants.
AcroForm or XFA fields. Per-field shape stubbed for v0.1, see UDM_SPEC.md §14.

advances.description: Optional explicit per-glyph advances (kerning, complex scripts).

transform.description: If present, takes precedence over x/y/rotation.

ocr.description: Marker that this run came from OCR, not from encoded text in the source.

Matrix2D.description: Affine 2D transformation matrix in standard PDF/SVG form: `[a b 0; c d 0; e f 1]`, where (e, f) is the translation.

cells.description: Sparse cell map keyed by A1 address.

display.description: Cached display string from the source.

SlideShape.description: A shape on a slide. Reuses fixed-mode `Layer` for positioning, plus placeholder semantics from the slide layout system.

primary.description: Which mode the document is "primarily" in. Editor uses this to pick the default editing tool and toolbar.
